notes: Fixed big FPS spikes: a ▬▬▬ chat line held for a loot roll was put back into chat over and over, and every mod re-read it each time
Powder mining chests count again: putting that line back could end a chest's loot before its rewards came in
Held chat lines now go straight back into chat, so other mods' trackers don't count those drops twice
Works with chat-compacting mods: "REWARDS (5)" isn't counted as an item
